items.title: JJ Johnson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: My sister is very sharp on remembering things like what you are asking about.

ctx.x: She’s very good on family history. I’m terrible. My memory disappoints me so often and so many times it’s embarrassing. My sister is very sharp on remembering things like what you are asking about. How did my mom and dad ever meet? She’ll tell you. I’ve go to find that out myself.
And once your mom and dad married and settled down and started a family, you were the first child in the family to be born?
